name: Life Planning
description: Clarify → Plan → Act → Reflect, a lightweight loop.

phases.title: Clarify
phases.description: Get clear on what you want and why.
aiInstructions: Write the motivation and the ideal outcome into goals of context.json.
Record the one thing that matters most (this cycle's focus) as a decision.

phases.title: Plan
phases.description: Break it into steps small enough to finish.
aiInstructions: Break the focus into small tasks finishable within a week — smaller is better.

phases.title: Act
aiInstructions: Advance one task at a time; when stuck, mark it blocked and write down the sticking point — never grind through.

phases.title: Reflect
phases.description: Keep a record and decide the next cycle.
aiInstructions: Review what worked and what did not, and write it up as a decision.
Decide the next cycle's focus and return to Clarify (start a new project or adjust the goals).
